units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL HTTP integration suite for Issue wake diagnostics, including wake/activity projection, diagnosis, trust-boundary redaction, tenant isolation and output caps.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises the public Express Issue route against the real database schema and shared low-trust preset; route/API behavior depends inward on Issue, Run, wake-request, activity and authorization-policy data.
units.keyDataModels: Company, board or Agent actor, Project, Issue and blocks relation, Agent authorization policy, HeartbeatRun context snapshot, AgentWakeupRequest, ActivityLog and diagnostic event projection.
units.lifecycle: Seed an Issue and related execution state; collect recent wake/activity rows; infer blockers-resolved state when no wake exists; redact records outside the caller boundary; classify and summarize; cap and return a diagnostic projection.
units.testAssessment: Seven integration cases cover payload/error stripping, empty history, inferred no-row state, low-trust hidden blocker and identifier redaction, uniform cross-tenant 404, allowlisted failure/activity projection and 50-row caps. Focused Vitest skipped all seven because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Missing are ordinary human-role authorization, stable machine codes, event-count/timing leakage, pagination, retention, immutable evidence, malformed actions and exhaustive projection allowlisting.
units.designRationale: Give operators and scoped Agents enough evidence to explain wake behavior without exposing raw queue payloads, stack errors or resources outside the execution boundary.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs responsibility-safe operational diagnostics that let a human explain why work did or did not wake while preserving tenant, data-contract and Connector boundaries.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the allowlisted projection, uniform not-found behavior, hidden-resource redaction, normalized categories and explicit caps. Replace prose-as-contract with stable diagnosisCode/eventCode plus structured parameters; authorize separate human and Agent views; suppress or bucket counts/timestamps where they reveal hidden activity; bind events to immutable work, responsibility-contract and evidence IDs; define retention/export policy and pagination.
units.responsibilityConflict: A deterministic English sentence is presentation, not an auditable decision contract. Identifier redaction alone can still reveal hidden activity through event count/order/timing, and the suite does not prove that a requesting human is the accountable or authorized reviewer. Diagnostic events are not shown bound to an immutable responsibility/evidence chain.

units.securityFindings: POSITIVE: raw payload/details/triggerDetail/error are excluded; unknown private reasons collapse to other; hidden Issue, Agent, Run and hold identifiers are removed; cross-company reads return uniform 404. HIGH: low-trust callers still receive two redacted events, so count/order/timing can form a side channel. HIGH: board authorization is tested only with an instance-admin operator actor. MEDIUM: English diagnosis strings and Issue not found text are unstable contracts. MEDIUM: no exhaustive action/reason allowlist, retention/export or immutable-evidence tests are demonstrated. TEST LIMITATION: all seven focused tests skipped on this host.
